## neutral-ffmpeg

| file | header (first sentence) |
|---|---|
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/decoder.rs` | [Decoder]: ffmpeg decodes a file, the crate reads raw frames from its standard output. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/encoder.rs` | [Encoder]: raw frames in, an encoded file out. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/error.rs` | Error type shared by every module of the crate. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/exec.rs` | Run a program to completion with a hard deadline. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/filter.rs` | [Filter]: raw frames in, raw frames out, through an ffmpeg -vf filter graph. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/framebuf.rs` | [FrameBuf]: one frame of raw video in the layout ffmpeg -f rawvideo uses. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/json.rs` | A small std-only JSON parser, enough for ffprobe's output. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/lib.rs` | Bridge to ffmpeg that runs it as a separate process and moves raw frames over pipes. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/locate.rs` | Finding the ffmpeg and ffprobe executables. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/pixfmt.rs` | Pixel format table and frame geometry. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/probe.rs` | ffprobe wrapper: run it with JSON output and read the fields a media plugin needs. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/process.rs` | Child process plumbing shared by the decoder, encoder, filter and probe: spawn with piped standard streams, drain standard error on a thread so that no pipe... |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/src/sizeprobe.rs` | Learning the size of the frames an ffmpeg command is going to produce. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/tests/errors.rs` | Error paths: what the caller sees when ffmpeg or the input is wrong. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/tests/filter_live.rs` | Filter graphs run through ffmpeg: identity, pixel format changes, size changes, frame count changes and the no-deadlock guarantee. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/tests/locate.rs` | Resolution order of ffmpeg and ffprobe, using real files under CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/tests/loopback.rs` | Decoder and Encoder against real ffmpeg: generate frames from lavfi sources, encode them losslessly, decode them again and compare byte for byte. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/tests/parity.rs` | Byte-for-byte agreement between the crate and ffmpeg's own output. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/tests/pixfmt_live.rs` | The pixel format table against the live ffmpeg and ffprobe. |
| `crates/neutral-ffmpeg/tests/probe_live.rs` | ffprobe wrapper against files generated with lavfi sources. |
